specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: Imported from China (Yueda Kia), it is powered by a Smartstream G1.5 MPi that produces 113 hp and 144 Nm of torque, paired with either a 6-speed manual transmission (LX) or an IVT (EX and SX).

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: Three engine options are available: a 1.0-litre T-GDi turbocharged petrol, a 1.2-litre MPi petrol and a 1.5-litre CRDi turbocharged diesel.
